sentences.japanese: 私は海の近くに住んでいるのでよく海岸に行きます。
sentences.english: I live near the sea, so I often get to go to the beach.

sentences.japanese: 君の誕生日が近づいているね。
君の願いは近い将来実現するだろう。
sentences.english: Your wish will come true in the near future.

sentences.japanese: 君の家の近くに住めたらいいのに。
sentences.english: I wish I could live near your house.

sentences.japanese: 空港はすぐ近くにあります。
sentences.english: The airport is close at hand.
